role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 能够逃过沙王伏击的寥寥无几。他从地下突袭敌人，将他们晕在原地，再操控终极技能释放出数波致命的震荡，摧毁周围的一切，而敌人的反击则被隐藏在沙暴中的他尽数躲过。
hero_summary_en: Not many can survive an ambush from Sand King. Demolishing everything around him with waves of deadly vibration from his ultimate, he evades counterattacks by hiding himself in a scouring gust of sand, and stuns foes by striking them from beneath.

abilities.name: sandking_burrowstrike
abilities.description_zh: 沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
abilities.description_en: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: sandking_sand_storm
abilities.description_zh: 沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得隐身效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
abilities.description_en: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
notes_zh: 沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。%fade_delay%秒后将再次隐形。
notes_en: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
facet_text_en: Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.
facet_text_zh: 沙尘暴的作用范围提升，并且沙王在其中获得隐身效果。
沙尘暴能以%sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%%沙王移速的速度跟随沙王，并且只要和沙王相距不超过%sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster%就不会消失。
当沙王在沙尘暴中攻击敌人时，他会对目标施加致盲的负面状态。

abilities.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
abilities.description_zh: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心%inner_radius%范围内敌人将受到%inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
abilities.description_en: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

shard_loc.en: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.
shard_loc.zh: 被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

abilities.name: sandking_caustic_finale
abilities.description_zh: 沙王的攻击对敌方单位注入毒液，使他们死亡时发生剧烈爆炸，造成固定数值的伤害加上基于阵亡单位最大生命值的额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

abilities.name: sandking_epicenter
abilities.description_zh: 经过%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
abilities.description_en: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
notes_zh: 地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
notes_en: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.

scepter_loc.en: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).
scepter_loc.zh: 地震的脉冲开始时每%spine_tick_rate%秒会在随机地点产生%scepter_explosions_per_pulse%片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的%scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%%，对击中的敌人造成%spine_damage_pct%%%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生%shard_explosions_per_pulse%次攻击。

shard_loc.en: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
shard_loc.zh: 每%shard_interval%秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_sand_king_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: Enemy units in range of Sand Storm have their movement speed slowed by {s:bonus_sand_storm_slow}% and miss {s:bonus_blind_pct}% of their attacks.
